g.text: One fixed bank extension: 245 placements. Margin −1 and all LS7G signal fits stay fixed.
Closed-data diagnosis: 3,540 digital trials on ten reused sector-29 backgrounds; no independent false-alarm estimate.
Panel C uses injection truth and is not an available veto for native events. No detector or candidate is adopted.
